instruction.text: Read the text. What stands out?

atoms.text: The classroom was loud and chaotic and every student wanted attention. The clock on the wall showed that time was only passing by slowly. Sarah sat quietly in the corner, not focusing on the noise, but thinking of other things.

atoms.b: The classroom was ((a jungle of noise and chaos)), where every student seemed to ask for attention. The clock on the wall ((glared down angrily)), while time was only passing slowly. Sarah sat quietly in the corner, ((her mind drifting like a leaf in the wind)), lost in daydreams far from the noise.
